trial_design_summary: Quarterback trial in HPV+ oropharyngeal carcinoma: after induction TPF, clinical responders randomized 1:2 to standard-dose chemoradiation (7000 cGy) vs reduced-dose chemoradiation (5600 cGy) with weekly carboplatin; abstract does not describe a non-responder arm.

arms.evidence: randomized 1:2 to sdCRT (7000 cGy) or rdCRT (5600 cGy) with weekly carboplatin

arms.arm_name: Arm C (Non-responders: Standard CRT + Carboplatin + Erbitux + Paclitaxel)

arms.evidence: after induction chemotherapy (IC), reduced dose chemoradiation (rdCRT) would result in equivalent PFS and OS compared to sdCRT

trial_design_summary: S0307 phase III adjuvant breast cancer trial comparing three bisphosphonates head-to-head (intravenous zoledronic acid vs oral clodronate vs oral ibandronate); no designated standard comparator arm, so arm roles are not assignable.

PMID-MISMATCH: abstract describes AALL1131 randomization of intrathecal triple therapy versus intrathecal methotrexate for CNS prophylaxis, not the VHR/HR/Ph-like dasatinib/Down syndrome risk-stratification arms listed in arm_names.

arms.arm_name: Very High Risk (VHR) B-ALL - Control Arm

trial_design_summary: JAVELIN Gastric 100 phase III trial: after first-line induction chemotherapy, gastric/GEJ cancer patients without progression randomized 1:1 to avelumab maintenance vs continued chemotherapy; abstract does not describe a best-supportive-care-only arm.

arms.evidence: randomly assigned 1:1 to avelumab 10 mg/kg every 2 weeks or continued chemotherapy
We investigated avelumab (anti-programmed death ligand-1 [PD-L1]) maintenance after first-line induction chemotherapy

trial_design_summary: CheckMate 9ER phase 3 open-label trial in previously untreated advanced renal-cell carcinoma comparing nivolumab plus cabozantinib versus sunitinib; abstract does not describe a nivolumab+ipilimumab+cabozantinib triplet arm.

arms.evidence: Nivolumab plus Cabozantinib versus Sunitinib for Advanced Renal-Cell Carcinoma
we randomly assigned adults with previously untreated clear-cell, advanced renal-cell carcinoma to receive either nivolumab plus cabozantinib

trial_design_summary: ECOG-ACRIN EA1131 phase III postoperative trial in residual triple-negative breast cancer post-NAC: platinum-based chemotherapy tested for noninferiority/superiority versus established adjuvant capecitabine; abstract does not describe an observation arm.

arms.evidence: iDFS would not be inferior but improved in patients with basal subtype TNBC treated with adjuvant platinum compared with capecitabine
high-risk for recurrence, which is reduced by adjuvant capecitabine ... assuming a 4-year iDFS of 67% with capecitabine

trial_design_summary: Total XVI pharmacodynamic study: ALL patients randomized in continuation to lower (2500 IU/m2) versus higher (3500 IU/m2) IV pegaspargase doses within risk strata; low-risk is a stratum, not an intervention/control designation.

arms.evidence: randomized in continuation to receive 2500 IU/m2 or 3500 IU/m2 IV ... continuously (15 doses) on the standard/high risk (SHR) arms
randomized in continuation to receive 2500 IU/m2 or 3500 IU/m2 IV ... continuously (15 doses) on the standard/high risk (SHR) arms

trial_design_summary: ABCSG-16/SALSA phase 3 trial: postmenopausal HR+ breast cancer patients after 5 years of endocrine therapy randomized to 2 additional years versus 5 additional years of anastrozole; the 2-year extension is the reference comparator.

arms.evidence: anastrozole for an additional 2 years ... or an additional 5 years (5-year group, receiving a total of 10 years)
extending hormone therapy by 5 years provided no benefit over a 2-year extension

trial_design_summary: CPT-SIOP-2000 randomized high-risk choroid plexus tumors head-to-head between two chemotherapy regimens (CarbEV vs CycEV); no established standard existed, so neither arm is a designated control.

CheckMate 816 phase 3 trial in resectable NSCLC comparing neoadjuvant nivolumab plus platinum-based chemotherapy versus platinum-based chemotherapy alone; abstract does not describe a nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab arm.

arms.evidence: to receive nivolumab plus platinum-based chemotherapy or platinum-based chemotherapy alone, followed by resection
neoadjuvant nivolumab plus chemotherapy resulted in significantly longer event-free survival ... than chemotherapy alone

trial_design_summary: SEQUOIA phase 3 trial in untreated CLL/SLL: patients without del(17p) randomized to zanubrutinib (group A) versus bendamustine-rituximab (group B); del(17p) patients in group C received zanubrutinib. Abstract does not describe a venetoclax+zanubrutinib arm.

arms.evidence: randomly assigned patients without del(17)(p13.1) to zanubrutinib (group A) or bendamustine-rituximab (group B)
Zanubrutinib is a next-generation, selective Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitor ... We compared zanubrutinib with bendamustine-rituximab

trial_design_summary: MAGNITUDE phase III double-blind trial in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: patients assigned 1:1 to niraparib plus abiraterone acetate/prednisone versus placebo plus AAP; abstract does not describe a fixed-dose-combination Cohort 3 arm.

arms.evidence: Patients were assigned 1:1 to receive niraparib + AAP or placebo + AAP
Combination treatment with niraparib + AAP significantly lengthened rPFS in patients with HRR+ mCRPC compared with standard-of-care AAP

trial_design_summary: LASER301 phase III trial in treatment-naive EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC: patients randomized 1:1 to third-generation lazertinib versus first-generation gefitinib; abstract does not describe an open-label lazertinib cross-over arm.

arms.evidence: Patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to lazertinib 240 mg once daily orally or gefitinib 250 mg once daily orally
Lazertinib is a potent, CNS-penetrant, third-generation epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) tyrosine kinase inhibitor

trial_design_summary: Pooled report of the ipatasertib/atezolizumab/paclitaxel triplet across three first-line mTNBC studies (two single-arm, plus randomized IPATunity170); abstract reports only the 317 triplet-treated patients and does not describe the randomized comparator/doublet/placebo arms' roles.

arms.evidence: Triplet therapy comprised intravenous atezolizumab ... oral ipatasertib ... and intravenous paclitaxel ... as first-line therapy

trial_design_summary: CheckMate 722 phase III trial in EGFR-mutated metastatic NSCLC after progression on EGFR TKIs: patients randomized 1:1 to nivolumab plus platinum-doublet chemotherapy versus platinum-doublet chemotherapy alone; abstract does not describe a nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab arm.

arms.evidence: randomly assigned 1:1 to nivolumab ... plus platinum-doublet chemotherapy ... or platinum-doublet chemotherapy alone
evaluated nivolumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer
